messages.subject: HURDLE MODEL
parts:
Hi inla users!


I’m trying to fit a hurdle model with the next structure:








being $h$ a beta density, Z fixed effects and f_{ij} an spatial effect which both predictors are sharing.


I would like to fit and make predictions using this model using INLA. Can you help me? 


Thank you so much,


Best wishes.

Joaquín.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] HURDLE MODEL
parts:
you have to do this using two likelihood contributions, so
family = c("binomial", "beta")

if y=0, then you observe the zero component with prob p.

if y>0, is observed, you observe first a non-zero component with prob
1-p, and then the non-zero beta observation with density f.beta(y)

with this, you can have a linear predictor model for both p, and the
beta-distr

there is a discussion of this issue (about rain-fall) in the spde-
tutorial.

H
